svg.title: A test sheet: ten minutes of tone on every input. The converter's channels, drawn as an amber waveform, carry red click marks at 66.7, 133.3 and 200 seconds and every 66.7 seconds after; the stage-box channels, in blue, are clean. Note: takes under a minute never click.
svg.text: STUDIO A · TEN MINUTES OF TONE, EVERY INPUT
a click every 66.7 s · converter channels only
takes shorter than a minute never click
